sources.title: T-Tech's Merged Qwen3-32B Handles 116M Requests, Beats Qwen3-235B | AI ...
sources.snippet: T-Tech consolidated 200+ internal applications onto a single Qwen3-32B model, absorbing 50% of platform traffic and 116M requests per month. The merged model surpasses Qwen3-235B-A22B-Instruct-2507, roughly seven times larger by parameters, scoring 69.6 vs 65.8 on the in-house arena.
